doctor.en: My aunt took me to the doctor when I had a fever.
doctor.zh: 我发烧时，阿姨带我去看了医生。

fireman.en: The brave fireman saved a cat from the tall tree.
fireman.zh: 勇敢的消防队员从高树上救下了一只猫。

farmer.en: The farmer grows fresh vegetables and sells them at the market.
farmer.zh: 那位农民种植新鲜蔬菜，并在市场上出售。

cook.en: The cook in our school makes yummy pizza for lunch.
cook.zh: 我们学校的厨师为午餐做了美味的比萨。

police.en: The police helped the lost boy find his mother.
police.zh: 警察帮助迷路的小男孩找到了他的妈妈。

police officer.en: A police officer stopped the car to check the driver's license.
police officer.zh: 一位警察拦下汽车检查司机的驾照。

station.en: We waited for the train at the station for twenty minutes.
station.zh: 我们在车站等了二十分钟的火车。

police station.en: The man went to the police station to report his lost wallet.
police station.zh: 那名男子去警察局报告他丢失的钱包。

worker.en: My uncle is a worker who builds houses in the city.
worker.zh: 我的叔叔是一名工人在城里建造房屋。

aunt.en: My aunt bakes delicious cookies every Sunday afternoon.
aunt.zh: 我的姑母每个周日下午都会烤美味的饼干。

night.en: We saw many bright stars in the sky last night.
night.zh: 昨晚我们看到了天空中许多明亮的星星。

owl.en: The owl hunts for mice and insects in the dark night.
owl.zh: 猫头鹰在黑暗的夜晚捕食老鼠和昆虫。

night owl.en: My sister is a night owl and stays up late reading books.
night owl.zh: 我姐姐是个夜猫子，总是熬夜看书。

driver.en: The bus driver stops at every station to let people get on.
driver.zh: 公交车司机在每个站停下来让乘客上车。

taxi.en: We took a yellow taxi to the airport this morning.
taxi.zh: 今天早上我们乘了一辆黄色出租车去机场。

safe.en: Always wear a helmet when riding a bike to stay safe.
safe.zh: 骑自行车时总是戴头盔以保持安全。

nurse.en: The nurse gave me a bandage after I fell down.
nurse.zh: 我摔倒后，护士给了我一个创可贴。

light.en: Turn on the light so you can see your homework clearly.
light.zh: 打开灯，这样你就能看清楚你的作业了。

uncle.en: My uncle lives in a small town and visits us every summer.
uncle.zh: 我叔叔住在一个小镇上，每年夏天来看我们。

bake.en: My mom and I bake cookies together every Sunday afternoon.
bake.zh: 我和妈妈每个周日下午一起烤饼干。

bee.en: A bee landed on the flower and collected some nectar.
bee.zh: 一只蜜蜂落在花上，采了一些花蜜。

often.en: I often walk my dog in the park after dinner.
often.zh: 我经常在晚饭后去公园遛狗。

field.en: The children are playing soccer in the big green field.
field.zh: 孩子们在大绿地上踢足球。

painter.en: The painter used bright colors to paint a rainbow on the wall.
painter.zh: 画家用了鲜艳的颜色在墙上画了一道彩虹。

use.en: I use a pencil to draw a picture of my cat.
use.zh: 我用铅笔给我的猫画了一幅画。

brush.en: My dad uses a brush to paint the wall in our room.
brush.zh: 我爸爸用刷子给我们房间的墙刷漆。

scientist.en: A scientist studies plants and animals in the forest.
scientist.zh: 科学家在森林里研究植物和动物。

writer.en: The writer writes stories about a brave little mouse.
writer.zh: 这位作家写关于一只勇敢小老鼠的故事。

same.en: My twin sister and I often wear the same dress.
same.zh: 我和我的双胞胎妹妹经常穿同样的裙子。

sound.en: I hear the sound of rain hitting the window at night.
sound.zh: 晚上我听到雨打窗户的声音。

postman.en: The postman rides a bike to deliver letters every day.
postman.zh: 邮递员每天骑自行车送信。

life.en: My dog has a happy life with lots of walks and treats.
life.zh: 我的狗生活很幸福，有很多散步和零食。

mountain.en: We climb the mountain to see the beautiful sunrise.
mountain.zh: 我们爬上山去看美丽的日出。

laugh.en: My little brother makes me laugh when he tells jokes.
laugh.zh: 我弟弟讲笑话时逗得我哈哈大笑。

sad.en: I feel sad when my best friend moves to another city.
sad.zh: 我最好的朋友搬到另一个城市时，我很难过。

scared.en: My little sister is scared of the dark in her room.
scared.zh: 我妹妹害怕她房间里的黑暗。

angry.en: My dad gets angry when I don't clean my room.
angry.zh: 当我不打扫房间时，我爸爸会生气。

excited.en: The kids were excited about their school trip to the zoo.
excited.zh: 孩子们对去动物园的学校旅行感到兴奋。

opera.en: My grandma loves to watch Chinese opera on TV every weekend.
opera.zh: 我奶奶每个周末都喜欢在电视上看中国歌剧。

next.en: We will visit my cousin next Saturday morning.
next.zh: 我们下周六早上会去拜访我的表弟。

cough.en: Please cover your mouth when you cough in class.
cough.zh: 在课堂上咳嗽时请捂住你的嘴。

better.en: After taking the medicine, Tom felt much better today.
better.zh: 吃了药后，汤姆今天感觉好多了。

gift.en: I bought a colorful gift for my best friend's birthday party.
gift.zh: 我为最好朋友的生日派对买了一个彩色的礼物。

model.en: My brother built a model airplane with his dad last night.
model.zh: 我哥哥昨晚和他爸爸一起搭了一个模型飞机。

shout.en: Don't shout in the library; people are reading quietly.
shout.zh: 不要在图书馆里大喊；人们正在安静地读书。

should.en: You should brush your teeth before going to bed every night.
should.zh: 你应该每晚睡觉前刷牙。

feeling.en: I have a funny feeling that someone is watching us.
feeling.zh: 我有一种奇怪的感觉，好像有人在看着我们。

huge.en: The elephant at the zoo is huge and very friendly.
huge.zh: 动物园里的大象巨大且非常友好。

worried.en: My mom looked worried when I had a high fever.
worried.zh: 我发高烧时，妈妈看起来很担心。

street.en: We must look both ways before crossing the street.
street.zh: 过马路前我们必须两边都看看。

hit.en: The baseball hit the window and broke it.
hit.zh: 棒球撞到了窗户，把它打碎了。

talent.en: Her talent for drawing won her first prize.
talent.zh: 她的绘画天赋为她赢得了一等奖。

act.en: The students will act out a funny story in class.
act.zh: 学生们将在课堂上表演一个有趣的故事。

magic.en: The magician performed a magic trick with a rabbit.
magic.zh: 魔术师用一只兔子表演了一个魔术。

shine.en: Your hard work will make you shine in the show.
shine.zh: 你的努力会让你在表演中出众。

puzzle.en: I finished the 100-piece puzzle in just one hour.
puzzle.zh: 我仅用一小时就完成了100片的拼图。

dancer.en: The dancer moved gracefully across the stage.
dancer.zh: 舞蹈演员优雅地走过舞台。

win.en: Our team worked together to win the game.
win.zh: 我们队齐心协力赢得了比赛。

just.en: I just want to say thank you for your help.
just.zh: 我只是想说谢谢你的帮助。

boy.en: The little boy gave his seat to an old lady.
boy.zh: 那个小男孩把座位让给了一位老奶奶。

slowly.en: The turtle walked slowly across the garden path.
slowly.zh: 乌龟慢慢地穿过花园小径。

seed.en: She put a tiny seed into the pot of soil.
seed.zh: 她把一颗小小的种子放进花盆的土里。

earth.en: The worm wiggled deep in the wet earth.
earth.zh: 蚯蚓在湿润的泥土深处扭动着。

root.en: A big tree has a long root under the ground.
root.zh: 一棵大树在地下有一条长长的根。

stem.en: The flower's stem is green and very straight.
stem.zh: 花的茎是绿色的，而且非常直。

thin.en: My pencil is thin, but your pencil is thick.
thin.zh: 我的铅笔很细，但你的铅笔很粗。

leaf.en: A yellow leaf fell from the tall tree.
leaf.zh: 一片黄色的叶子从那棵大树上落下来。

dig.en: The boy is digging a hole in the garden.
dig.zh: 那个男孩正在花园里挖一个洞。

sunflower.en: The sunflower turns its face toward the sun.
sunflower.zh: 向日葵把它的脸转向太阳。

plant.en: We will plant some carrots in the garden.
plant.zh: 我们将在花园里种一些胡萝卜。

dream.en: My dream is to fly like a bird one day.
dream.zh: 我的梦想是有一天像鸟一样飞翔。

sleep.en: The baby cat likes to sleep in a warm box.
sleep.zh: 小猫喜欢在一个温暖的盒子里睡觉。

will.en: I will finish my homework before dinner.
will.zh: 我将在晚饭前完成我的作业。

true.en: It is true that the sun rises in the east every day.
true.zh: 太阳每天从东方升起是真的。

come true.en: Wishing on a star can make your wish come true.
come true.zh: 对着星星许愿能让你的愿望实现。

paper.en: She drew a big red flower on a piece of paper.
paper.zh: 她在一张纸上画了一朵大红花的。

fair.en: We bought candy apples and played games at the school fair.
fair.zh: 我们在学校集市上买了糖苹果并玩了游戏。

festival.en: Our town has a music festival every summer in the park.
festival.zh: 我们镇每年夏天在公园举办音乐节。

horn.en: The goat has two curved horns on its head.
horn.zh: 这只山羊头上长着两只弯曲的角。

dot.en: Put a red dot on the map to show your hometown.
dot.zh: 在地图上用红点标出你的家乡。

raindrop.en: A single raindrop landed on my nose during the walk.
raindrop.zh: 散步时一颗雨滴落在了我的鼻子上。

more.en: I want more cookies because they are so yummy.
more.zh: 我还想要更多饼干，因为它们太好吃了。

special.en: My grandma made a special cake for my birthday.
special.zh: 我奶奶为我的生日做了一个特别的蛋糕。

keeper.en: The zoo keeper feeds the lions every morning at eight.
keeper.zh: 动物园管理员每天早上八点喂狮子。

hey.en: Hey, don't forget to bring your umbrella today!
hey.zh: 嘿，今天别忘了带你的雨伞！

lovely.en: The little puppy is so lovely with its floppy ears.
lovely.zh: 这只小狗狗耷拉着耳朵，真可爱。

student.en: Every student in our class brings a storybook to share on Friday.
student.zh: 我们班的每个学生都在周五带一本故事书来分享。

culture.en: We learned about Chinese culture by making paper lanterns in art class.
culture.zh: 我们在美术课上通过制作纸灯笼了解了中国文化。

hour.en: My mom said we can play outside for one hour after dinner.
hour.zh: 我妈妈说晚饭后我们可以玩一个小时。

note.en: Please write a quick note in your notebook about today's science experiment.
note.zh: 请在你的笔记本上快速记下今天科学实验的笔记。

vote.en: Each child got one vote to choose the class pet for this year.
vote.zh: 每个孩子都有一张选票来选择今年的班级宠物。

design.en: Our group will design a colorful poster for the school art show.
design.zh: 我们小组将为学校艺术展设计一张彩色海报。

hometown.en: My hometown has a big park with a pond where ducks swim.
hometown.zh: 我的家乡有一个大公园，里面有鸭子游泳的池塘。

drama.en: The school drama club will perform a funny play next week.
drama.zh: 学校戏剧俱乐部下周将表演一出有趣的戏剧。

trip.en: Our class trip to the farm let us feed the baby goats.
trip.zh: 我们班的农场旅行让我们喂了小山羊。

T-shirt.en: I wore my favorite blue T-shirt with a dinosaur picture on it.
T-shirt.zh: 我穿了我最喜欢的蓝色T恤，上面有恐龙图案。

skirt.en: My sister has a red skirt with white polka dots for parties.
skirt.zh: 我妹妹有一条带白色圆点的红裙子，用来参加派对。

shorts.en: On hot summer days, I always wear shorts and a hat outside.
shorts.zh: 在炎热的夏日，我总是在外面穿短裤和戴帽子。

shirt.en: My dad wears a blue shirt to work every day.
shirt.zh: 我爸爸每天都穿蓝衬衫去上班。

trousers.en: She bought a pair of black trousers for the trip.
trousers.zh: 她为旅行买了一条黑裤子。

scarf.en: I wear a warm scarf when it is cold outside.
scarf.zh: 外面冷的时候我戴一条暖和的围巾。

sweater.en: His red sweater has a small hole in the sleeve.
sweater.zh: 他的红毛衣袖子上有个小洞。

dress.en: My sister's pink dress has pretty flowers on it.
dress.zh: 我姐姐的粉色连衣裙上有漂亮的花。

party.en: We are having a birthday party for my best friend.
party.zh: 我们要为我最好的朋友办一个生日派对。

dressmaker.en: The dressmaker made a lovely dress for the queen.
dressmaker.zh: 裁缝为女王做了一条可爱的连衣裙。

wrong.en: I got the wrong answer on the math test today.
wrong.zh: 今天数学考试我答错了。

clever.en: The clever dog opened the door by itself.
clever.zh: 那只聪明的狗自己打开了门。

whale.en: A big whale jumped out of the water near the boat.
whale.zh: 一头大鲸在船附近跳出了水面。

uniform.en: We wear a blue and white uniform to school every day.
uniform.zh: 我们每天穿蓝白相间的校服上学。

robe.en: After the bath, I put on my soft white robe.
robe.zh: 洗完澡后，我穿上柔软的白色长袍。
